name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova dialog, fixed: the close buttons take closeLabel, their name for other languages, where "Close" was written in. No taller than the window (the theme's, 1rem from its edges, for AlertDialog too); DialogBody is what scrolls between its header and footer, keyboard-reachable while it scrolls. Its footer's buttons sit under the content, without shadcn's ruled-off band (a stray line in dark, where the band hardly shows). DialogContent size="wide": a picker's (a list and a view), 768px wide and 640px tall whatever it shows, no taller than the window, on a phone the whole screen clear of the home indicator. It pops in and out by the theme's motion-pop (in at 150ms on --ease-enter, out at 100ms on --ease-exit), not shadcn's 100ms on `ease`. DialogContent takes size="full" too, for a reader or a viewer over the app: the window but for 32px round it (a className's max width or height keeps it centred), on a phone the whole screen. On a phone (under 640px) a default-size DialogContent is a sheet from the bottom: the screen's width, its top corners round, at most 90% of the screen, clear of the home indicator, sliding; it scrolls whole, its title with it (sheet={false} where it places itself). A default-size one's footer, the content's last, stays at its foot as the rest scrolls under it (a wide or full one's is laid out there), and on a short screen (short:) its buttons are in a row. The close button is 32px, 8px in, on the title's middle line, and the title keeps clear of it.
